# l4-skills

The L4 skills: the point-of-care work a DAK's roles carry (reviewing a client's history and the decision-support guidance, completing an SDC questionnaire and extracting it, applying decision support and activating accepted guidance, informing the client, recording a rationale), and briefing, building and running an L4 application. Package `smart-l4`.
